text:
alex: Heads-up: Customer TICKET-1287 (Acme) says invoice total != usage dashboard by $0.17. They attached PDF and dashboard export.
lina: Oof, small amount but customer worried about recurring drift. Do we have a quick repro?
marta: Usually rounding + currency conversion or VAT placement. Can you paste the invoice line-items?
alex: From PDF:
- text-generation: $12.34
- embeddings: $3.21
 subtotal shown: $15.55
 tax (VAT 20%): $3.11
 total: $18.66
 dashboard export sums tokens -> cost shows $18.49.
simon: That smells like per-request cent-rounding before aggregation. If each request cost is rounded to cents then summed, you can get a delta vs summing raw and rounding at the end.
marta: Exactly. Also check if currency conversion happened before tax calc. We had one merchant using EUR earlier where we converted per-line.
alex: Repro steps I ran locally: 1) simulate 1,000 requests with fractional-cent costs (e.g., 0.0123, 0.0237, ...) 2) sum rounded-per-request vs sum raw then round at invoice-level.
I used this snippet:
```python
costs = [0.0123, 0.0237, 0.0049] * 300
per_row = sum([round(c,2) for c in costs])
agg = round(sum(costs),2)
print(per_row, agg)
```
Result: per_row=18.66 agg=18.49 (matches customer).
lina: Thanks. So root cause confirmed.
marta: Action: billing infra currently does per-line rounding when emitting invoice PDF. Need to change to aggregate-first then round in invoice generator for domestic USD invoices. But for multi-currency we need to ensure conversion precision.
simon: I'll file infra PR to change generator to carry precision in cents using integer math (store micros or fractional cents) and only round at display. Also will add unit tests.
aliy: (bot) Noted: Billing parity check triggered for invoice_2026_02_acme.
billing-bot: Invoice generated: invoice_2026_02_acme.pdf (attached).
marta: Also finance wants an interim customer note: explain small rounding policy and offer $0.17 credit or apply to next invoice. @alex can you propose wording?
alex: Draft: "We traced this to per-request rounding in our invoice generator which can cause small differences vs the usage dashboard. We've issued a $0.17 credit and will fix generator to aggregate before rounding. Apologies for the confusion."
lina: LGTM.
simon: Timeline: hotfix PR today (non-breaking), roll to prod tomorrow, follow-up change for currency conversion next week.
marta: Assigning: simon for PR, alex for customer comms, finance to approve credit.
alex: I'll send to Acme and CC finance.
marta: Postmortem note: include reproducer script, unit tests, and note about VAT order-of-ops (apply tax to aggregated subtotal).
lina: Closing loop once credit applied and PR merged. :thumbsup:
alex: closing ticket after credit posted.
